subsystems.implemented_scope: Phase-0 startup fixture path is exported and fixture-backed, but `__libc_start_main`, `__frankenlibc_startup_phase0`, and snapshot capture remain host-backed in the support taxonomy.
subsystems.deferred_scope: Full native `csu`/TLS init-order hardening and secure-mode closure campaign remains open.
subsystems.doc_line: - `startup`: `IMPLEMENTED_PARTIAL` — fixture-backed phase-0 startup path is exported but support-taxonomy rows remain host-backed for `__libc_start_main`, `__frankenlibc_startup_phase0`, and snapshot capture. Deferred scope: full native `csu`/TLS init-order hardening and secure-mode closure campaign.

subsystems.implemented_scope: Runtime-math threading routing and selected pthread semantics are live, including lifecycle and rwlock native routing.
subsystems.doc_line: - `threading`: `IN_PROGRESS` — implemented scope: runtime-math threading routing and selected pthread semantics are live, including lifecycle and rwlock native routing. Deferred scope: close lifecycle/TLS stress beads.

subsystems.implemented_scope: Numeric, files, and native DNS lookups plus native addrinfo-list disposal are implemented; `getaddrinfo`, `getnameinfo`, and `freeaddrinfo` remain host-backed in the support taxonomy while installed NSS modules are loaded through the host bridge.
subsystems.deferred_scope: NSS breadth, policy/concurrency closure, and full retry/cache/poisoning hardening campaign remain open.
subsystems.doc_line: - `resolver`: `IMPLEMENTED_PARTIAL` — numeric, files, and native DNS lookups plus native addrinfo-list disposal are implemented; `getaddrinfo`, `getnameinfo`, and `freeaddrinfo` remain host-backed in the support taxonomy while installed NSS modules are loaded through the host bridge. Deferred scope: NSS breadth, policy/concurrency closure, and full retry/cache/poisoning hardening campaign.

subsystems.implemented_scope: Passwd/group reentrant APIs and `_nss_files_*` have native rows while primary lookup APIs remain host-backed in `pwd_abi`/`grp_abi`, and configured hosts modules share source-order/status actions across `getaddrinfo`, `getnameinfo`, and legacy hostent APIs via `gethostbyname4_r`, `gethostbyname3_r`, `gethostbyname2_r`, `gethostbyname_r`, and `gethostbyaddr2_r`/`gethostbyaddr_r`.
subsystems.deferred_scope: Standalone module support plus NSS concurrency/cache-coherence closure remain pending under `bd-rc0923-epic-eeuy4f.19`.
subsystems.doc_line: - `nss`: `IMPLEMENTED_PARTIAL` — passwd/group reentrant APIs and `_nss_files_*` have native rows while primary lookup APIs remain host-backed in `pwd_abi`/`grp_abi`, and configured hosts modules share source-order/status actions across `getaddrinfo`, `getnameinfo`, and legacy hostent APIs via `gethostbyname4_r`, `gethostbyname3_r`, `gethostbyname2_r`, `gethostbyname_r`, and `gethostbyaddr2_r`/`gethostbyaddr_r`. Deferred scope: standalone module support plus NSS concurrency/cache-coherence closure under `bd-rc0923-epic-eeuy4f.19`.

subsystems.implemented_scope: Bootstrap locale ABI path is implemented for `setlocale` and `localeconv`.
subsystems.doc_line: - `locale`: `IMPLEMENTED_PARTIAL` — implemented scope: bootstrap `setlocale`/`localeconv` C/POSIX path. Deferred scope: catalog, collation, and transliteration parity expansion.

subsystems.implemented_scope: `iconv_open`/`iconv`/`iconv_close` are native and the engine contains about 300 `Encoding` variants (`crates/frankenlibc-core/src/iconv/mod.rs` is ~54.5 kLOC, with generated tables in sibling files); codec scope/exclusions are locked in `tests/conformance/iconv_codec_scope_ledger.v1.json`.
subsystems.deferred_scope: Per-codec conformance and deterministic table-generation closure remain open.
subsystems.doc_line: - `iconv`: `IMPLEMENTED_PARTIAL` — `iconv_open`/`iconv`/`iconv_close` are native and the engine contains about 300 `Encoding` variants (`crates/frankenlibc-core/src/iconv/mod.rs` is ~54.5 kLOC, with generated tables in sibling files); codec scope/exclusions are locked in `tests/conformance/iconv_codec_scope_ledger.v1.json`. Deferred scope is per-codec conformance and deterministic table-generation closure, not the obsolete four-codec phase-1 breadth.
